chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Minqari, from Sufyan ibn 'Uyayna who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'I found the knowledge of all people in four things: the first is that you recognize your Lord; the second is that you recognize what He has done with you; the third is that you recognize what He intends from you; and the fourth is that you recognize what would remove you from your religion.'

key_terms.أَرْبَعٍ: four — the Imam's complete fourfold taxonomy encompassing all religious knowledge
key_terms.دِينِكَ: your religion — the covenant of faith that must be actively guarded
key_terms.رَبَّكَ: your Lord — God as sustainer, master, and object of gnosis (ma'rifa)
key_terms.عِلْمَ: knowledge — the totality of salvific, meaningful religious learning

ai.seo_question: What are the four categories of knowledge according to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distills all human knowledge into four essential recognitions: knowing God, knowing His grace toward you, knowing His will for you, and knowing what endangers your faith. This teaching, conveyed through the noted Sunni scholar Sufyan ibn 'Uyayna, presents a comprehensive epistemological framework for the religious life, making gnosis of God the foundation from which all other knowledge follows.
word_analysis: would remove you / takes you out
